premise: Gull asks Pelican why his beak is so big; he shows her his stretchy pouch, scoops up a pouchful of sea, and the second time up comes the rubber ring too.
inspiration: The 'why do you have such a big…' exchange of folk tale, turned from a trick into a show-and-tell that ends in a laugh.
lesson: Being different is something to show off.
learning: A pelican scoops water in its pouch and lets the water drain out.

en-US.title: Pelican's Pouch
en-US.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelican stood at the edge of the water, {pelican:face happy} with his big orange beak. {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to pelican} Gull came flapping over. [playfully] Pelican, why is your beak so BIG? {pelican:pulse} It isn't just a beak, said Pelican. Underneath, there's a pouch, like a stretchy bag. Watch! {pelican:live scoop} He dipped it down and scooped up a whole pouchful of water. {seagull:face surprised} Then he tipped his head, {sfx:pour} and the water poured out at the sides. Splish, splash! {pelican:spray} [short pause] Just then, {ring:enter} {ring:go to shore} the stripy rubber ring came bobbing in on a wave. {pelican:live scoop} Pelican scooped again. [gasps] Up came the water… and the ring! It sat on his beak like a hat, {ring:live spin} and spun round and round. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Gull laughed so much she squawked. {pelican:live laugh} Pelican laughed too. [playfully] Well, said Pelican, the water always drains out. But I think the ring is staying. {pelican:hearts}

es-ES.title: El buche de Pelícano
es-ES.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelícano estaba en la orilla, {pelican:face happy} con su gran pico naranja. {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to pelican} Gaviota llegó aleteando. [playfully] Pelícano, ¿por qué tienes un pico tan GRANDE? {pelican:pulse} No es solo un pico, dijo Pelícano. Debajo tengo una bolsa, que se estira como un saco. ¡Mira! {pelican:live scoop} Lo metió en el agua y sacó una bolsa entera llena de agua. {seagull:face surprised} Luego inclinó la cabeza, {sfx:pour} y el agua salió a chorros por los lados. ¡Chis, chas! {pelican:spray} [short pause] En ese momento, {ring:enter} {ring:go to shore} el flotador de rayas llegó flotando con una ola. {pelican:live scoop} Pelícano volvió a recoger agua. [gasps] Salió el agua… ¡y el flotador! Se le quedó en el pico como un sombrero, {ring:live spin} y daba vueltas y vueltas. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:live laugh} [laughs] Gaviota se rió tanto que graznó. {pelican:live laugh} Pelícano también se rió. [playfully] Bueno, dijo Pelícano, el agua siempre se escurre. Pero me parece que el flotador se queda. {pelican:hearts}
